name: whatsapp/open-self
description: Open WhatsApp Web on the 'Message yourself' chat, ready to type.

steps.note: The chat list takes a few seconds to sync after load.

Chat rows are drawn without accessible names in the main list, but the New chat panel names this one '@<you> (You) Message yourself'. It needs a REAL click: its UIA Invoke reports success and does nothing, which the expect would catch.
